# Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy) development packages WebKitGTK is configured against
# (.github/webkitgtk/build.sh). webkitgtk.yml installs them to build it, and
# dist.yml's AppImage job installs them too: the installed webkit2gtk-4.1.pc
# names them, and linuxdeploy bundles their runtime libraries from the build
# host. One package per line; a change here changes the cache key.
libatk-bridge2.0-dev
libatk1.0-dev
libatspi2.0-dev
libbrotli-dev
libcairo2-dev
libdrm-dev
libegl-dev
libenchant-2-dev

libfontconfig-dev
libfreetype-dev
libgbm-dev
libgcrypt20-dev
libgl-dev
libgles-dev
libglib2.0-dev
libgtk-3-dev
libharfbuzz-dev
libhyphen-dev
libicu-dev
libjpeg-dev
liblcms2-dev
libpng-dev
libseccomp-dev
libsoup-3.0-dev
libsqlite3-dev
libsysprof-capture-4-dev
libsystemd-dev
libtasn1-6-dev
libwayland-dev
libwebp-dev
libwoff-dev
libx11-dev
libxcomposite-dev
libxdamage-dev
libxkbcommon-dev
libxml2-dev
libxrender-dev
libxslt1-dev
libxt-dev
wayland-protocols
